    Demon Ash-Mark¶

    [!INFO] Marked in Ash, Weighed Warm — The Demon Does Not Cheat the Forge The ash-black measure of the Demon Continent — struck in warm iron flecked with Emberalden ash, still warm hours after minting. If it does not smoke when reheated, it is false.

    Base Units¶

    Forged in the ash-fields of Emberalden and Blazeyard and enforced by Asatru legions. Every true Ash weight is warm — high-magnesium slag holds heat at ~35 °C for 3 hours after casting; trapped moisture smokes on reheating in assay shape. The standard Ash-Mark bar is kept in Emberalden's ash-vault, covered in a finger of ash that never cools. Koebi, Kutra, and Malgardian smiths all cut to it; to cut light is to answer to Asatru.

    Domain Unit Relation Notes
    Length Ash base width of a thumb in ash ~ 2 cm — smallest practical ash-line
    Hand 5 Ash palm in ash
    Forearm 5 Hands 50 cm — forge forearm
    Ash-Rod 4 Forearms 2 m — mason's rod for basalt blocks
    Ash-March 1,000 Ash-Rods 2 km — legion march pace, ash-marked at each Rod
    Ember-League 5 Ash-Marches 10 km — between watch-fires. Demonic league
    Weight Ember base small ash-iron weight ~ 28.3 g — 1 Ounce, but warm
    Ash-Ounce 1 Ember same — ounce that smokes
    Mark 16 Embers the Ash-Mark — 453 g. 1 Mark = 1 Demonic Ember coin-weight. Named for the stamped mark that smokes when reheated
    Blaze 8 Marks 3.62 kg — forge blaze weight
    Furnace 10 Blazes 36.2 kg — furnace load
    Forge-Ton 28 Furnaces 1,014 kg — Demon Ton. Lighter than Erisian Ton, heavier than it looks
    Volume Ember-Cup base 200 mL — ash-cup
    Ash-Pot 8 Ember-Cups 1.6 L
    Cauldron 10 Ash-Pots 16 L — legion cauldron. Also one cauldron per ten demons ration rule
    Vat 10 Cauldrons 160 L

    Assay: a true Ash-Mark coin or weight, reheated over coals, smokes at the stamp. A cold fake does not. Every Demon's Horn trader carries a brazier.

    Who Uses¶

    The Demon Continent (17 nations + holdings) — Asatru, Emberalden, Blazeyard, Bloodcoast, Koebi, Kutra, Malgardian, Tita Tribe, Zakarutia, Maomodor Kingdom, and Yak Island holdings (including Yakut Territory). Also at Demon's Horn trade hub and Demon enclaves on Merratodoni and Kutten Sea routes.

    Merratodoni traders hate the Ash-Mark — warm weights burn pouches — but accept it for Demon iron, which is cheap and good.

    Conversion Notes¶

    • To Erisian Standard: 1 Ash-Mark (Weight) = 1.00 Erisian Pounds by treaty — Asatru insisted on parity to force acceptance, though the Demon Pound-iron is 456 g (0.5% heavy). 1 Ash-March = 2,187 Erisian Yards = 1.24 Erisian Miles. 1 Ember-League = 6.21 Erisian Miles.
    • To Vennerian Cable: 1 Ember-League = 5.4 Vennerian Nautical Miles. Demon ships at Demon's Horn list range in Ember-Leagues; Venner converts and charges pilotage.
    • To Dwarven Stone: 1 Ash-Rod = 7.14 Dwarven Stone. Dwarves respect the Ash-Rod — basalt does not lie.
    • Forge-Ton vs. others: 1 Demon Forge-Ton = 0.45 Erisian Tons = 0.98 Dwarven Tons — the Demon Ton is the lightest ton on Ge'or, which is why Demon iron quotes look cheap until you convert.
    • Romanium: Romanium is weighed in Ash-Marks when Demon forges handle it — 1 Ash-Mark Romanium = 1.006 Erisian Pounds Romanium. Asatru factors round down for allies, up for humans. Romanium assay on Demon Continent is always warm.

    Flavor¶

    Demon measure is heat and honesty enforced by spears. A false weight is not a civil offense but a forge offense — the smith who cuts light loses a finger, the second time a hand. Young Asatru legionaries learn the Ash-March by marching it in full ash until their calves remember 1,000 Rods better than any number. Children learn the Ember by holding it — if it is not warm, do not take it.

    At Demon's Horn, the proverb: Cool iron, cold heart — warm iron, true weight. A trader who complains the weight burned him is told then you know it is true.

    The ash on the standard bar in Emberalden has not been disturbed in a century — only the high smith may brush it, once a year, with a hawk feather.
